get.description: Returns a stable keyset page. The query string is limited to 8,192 bytes and rejects unknown or duplicate parameters. Up to five configured filters use `filter.{fieldKey}.{operator}`; equality kinds support `eq|ne`, while ordered kinds support `eq|ne|gt|gte|lt|lte`. A collection-locale publication change can return `DELIVERY_CURSOR_STALE`; restart from page one. Successful continuations receive a fresh 15-minute cursor. Total counts and page numbers are intentionally omitted.
